title: The Last Eclipse
styleReference: Premium 3D anime in three.js: cel-shaded characters with ink outlines in a painted world. An ancient city of floating temples over a bottomless abyss under a crimson eclipse; shattered stone bridges; blue lightning; drifting black ash. Kael's energy is always blue-white, Raizen's always crimson-black. No dialogue, no text, no logos.
cast:
Kael Arashi: original
Raizen Kuro: original

scenes.title: The Final Confrontation
scenes.logline: From an extreme-wide aerial over the shattered bridge, the camera descends between Kael and Raizen silhouetted against the crimson moon; blue lightning behind Kael, crimson energy along Raizen's sword; close-ups of their eyes; a low two-shot as both take their stances.
scenes.props: Voidfang; Graveheart; crimson eclipse; floating ruins; ash

scenes.title: Steel Against Steel
scenes.logline: Kael Flash Steps in; Raizen blocks; a ring of pressure scatters ash. Six exchanges: horizontal slash, overhead block, spinning counter, a duck under the blade, a double slash, and a weapon lock.
scenes.props: sparks; pressure wave; blue trails; crimson sparks

scenes.title: Speed Versus Strength
scenes.logline: Phantom Echo: two afterimages circle Raizen; his sweep shatters them into blue particles; the real Kael drops from above; Raizen catches the blade, then drives him back with a shockwave.

scenes.title: The Crimson Rupture
scenes.logline: Raizen slams Graveheart into the bridge; crimson fractures race toward Kael, who leaps between collapsing pillars, cuts a falling slab, lands on a surviving ledge, and charges his blade with lightning.

scenes.title: Heaven Splitter Versus Eclipse Devourer
scenes.logline: Kael's sword becomes an enormous blue-white arc; Raizen forms a crimson-black sphere that pulls debris inward; they charge; the collision holds in slow motion, then a dome of light expands across the skyline.
scenes.props: energy arc; vortex sphere; energy dome

scenes.title: The Choice
scenes.logline: The light fades; Kael kneels, Raizen stands with his sword lowered; the fractured Eclipse Core floats between them; Kael reaches toward it instead of attacking; Raizen's grip loosens.
